projectDescription: A Minecraft mod (Fabric & NeoForge) that lets players and modpack creators add custom advancements, remove or filter existing ones, enforce advancement progression, and fully customize the advancement screen.
keyFeatures: Add fully custom advancements via JSON files placed in the customadvancements/ folder
Remove or filter any vanilla or mod advancements using a blacklist (or whitelist mode)
Disable recipe advancements globally with a single config flag
Advancement progression system — require parent completion before a child can be earned
Reset all advancement progress on player death
Custom backgrounds: IMAGE, TEXTURE, COLOR, LINEAR_GRADIENT, RADIAL_GRADIENT types
Tab sorting modes: ALPHABETICALLY, DEFINED_LIST, or UNSORTED
In-game commands to generate advancement JSON files and export advancement IDs
Multi-language (i18n) support for advancement titles and descriptions
Works as a datapack-like system across all worlds (Fabric and NeoForge)
publicApiSurface: customadvancements.toml config: noRecipeAdvancements, advancementsBlacklist, blacklistIsWhitelist, disableStandardAdvancements
customadvancements.toml config: advancementProgressionMode (ALL, MODS, MINECRAFT, CUSTOM_ADVANCEMENTS)
customadvancements.toml config: advancementTabSortingMode (UNSORTED, ALPHABETICALLY, DEFINED_LIST), advancementSortingList
BackgroundType enum: NONE, IMAGE, TEXTURE, LINEAR_GRADIENT, RADIAL_GRADIENT, COLOR
AdvancementProgressionMode enum: ALL, MODS, MINECRAFT, CUSTOM_ADVANCEMENTS
